title: krot-agent chart values
description: Validated against the krot-agent chart templates. The nodes list is the gitops surface for what a node serves: every field maps 1:1 onto the agent.yaml spec POSTed to the control plane, so a shape the agent would reject is refused here instead.

quantity.description: Kubernetes resource quantity: a number or a string with an optional suffix (m, Mi, Gi, ...).

stringMap.description: String-to-string map, as required by Kubernetes labels and annotations.

repository.description: Image repository. An empty one renders `image: ":<tag>"`, which the kubelet refuses with InvalidImageName.

tag.description: Rendered verbatim after the ':' separator; empty falls back to .Chart.AppVersion, which is why it may be empty here.

inboundSpec.description: One inbound a node serves. The type decides which fields are meaningful: vless_ws is the only one that gets a Service and an Ingress, and the only one that reads publicEndpoint/publicPort/wsPath/originTls.

tag.description: Inbound tag; also the Service port name for a vless_ws inbound, so it has to be a name Kubernetes accepts.

type.description: Inbound kind the agent renders. Anything else is refused by the agent's own spec validation.

listenPort.description: Port the inbound binds on the node.

sni.description: TLS server name the inbound presents; also the Ingress rule host for a vless_ws inbound, so it has to be a bare hostname.

publicEndpoint.description: Public DNS name a CDN edge reaches the inbound on (vless_ws).

publicPort.description: Public port a CDN edge reaches the inbound on (vless_ws).

wsPath.description: WebSocket path the inbound serves (vless_ws); also the Ingress path.

originTls.description: Whether the inbound terminates TLS itself behind the edge (vless_ws).

nodeSpec.description: One node: a Deployment, a spec ConfigMap, and (for vless_ws inbounds) a Service and an Ingress.

name.description: Server name in the control plane; also the resource name suffix, so it has to be a name Kubernetes accepts.

node.description: Kubernetes node hostname the pod is pinned to (nodeSelector).

endpoint.description: Public DNS name pointing at the node's IP.

routeProfile.description: Routing profile compiled into the agent.

inbounds.description: What the node serves. An empty list renders a node with no listener, which is a valid drained state but never a useful one - the agent would serve nothing.

cpUrl.description: Control-plane base URL. The key is required; an empty value is refused by the template, because the agent fails fast with 'KROT_CP_URL is required' and a pod that never starts is worse than a failed render.

pollInterval.description: Desired-state poll interval, as a Go duration string.

agentTokenSecretName.description: Secret holding the registration token under key 'token'. The key is required; an empty name is refused by the template, because it renders a secretKeyRef the API server refuses.

dnsPolicy.description: Pod DNS policy. The agent pods are hostNetwork, so ClusterFirst resolves nothing; Default means the node's resolv.conf and ClusterFirstWithHostNet means cluster DNS.

nodes.description: One Deployment per entry. An empty list renders no workload at all, which is a valid way to install the chart before any node is declared.

tlsSecretName.description: TLS secret name; empty renders those Ingress objects without a tls block.

readTimeout.description: nginx proxy read/send timeout for the websocket inbounds, in seconds.
